scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
What do you wan te withz me? Be gone!
scripts.translation:
[纏頭巾的盜賊]
你想幹什麼？快滾開！

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
You have no more business with me, go away!
scripts.translation:
[纏頭巾的盜賊]
你跟我沒什麼好談的，走開！

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
E'llo mah frien, would I interesst tu with this rare mask? Its value I assure you is real mah frien. Tis manific!
scripts.translation:
[纏頭巾的盜賊]
嘿，朋友，看看這稀有的面具，感興趣嗎？
我保證它物有所值，朋友。
真是件好東西！

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
Ack! Forgez it! I can do bettaz en elsez where!
scripts.translation:
[纏頭巾的盜賊]
啊！算了！
我去別處還能賣個更好的價錢！

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
Wah? O ho ho ho, so you know thaz I steal dis from those savages no? Well I won'tz give it back. But I will for a pricez... wat you say?
scripts.translation:
[纏頭巾的盜賊]
什麼？哦呵呵呵，原來你知道這是我從那些野蠻人那裡偷來的？
我可不會還回去。
不過嘛，出個好價錢就另當別論... 你說呢？

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
Ahh a business man are you no?  Fine, how about...
scripts.translation:
[纏頭巾的盜賊]
啊，看來你也是個生意人？
好吧，這個價怎麼樣...

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
Hmmm... you drive a hard bargain, ok... my final offer...
scripts.translation:
[纏頭巾的盜賊]
嗯... 你可真會砍價。
好吧... 這可是我的底價了...

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
Are youz playin wit me? You don't have ze money!
scripts.translation:
[纏頭巾的盜賊]
你耍我呢？
你根本沒那麼多錢！

scripts.text:
[Turban Thief]
O ho ho, it's a deal, then!
scripts.translation:
[纏頭巾的盜賊]
哦呵呵，成交！
